introHtml: Sport Tek sweatshirts combine moisture-wicking performance with a classic athletic fit, making them a top choice for corporate teams, event staff, and safety crews who need durable, comfortable apparel. Unlike standard cotton sweatshirts, Sport Tek fabrics resist shrinking and fading after repeated washes, so your logo stays sharp season after season. Whether you're outfitting a sales team for a trade show or rewarding employees with a premium uniform, these sweatshirts accept embroidery and screen printing cleanly. Choose from pullovers or zip-front styles in a range of sizes from XS to 3XL.
